coordinate_system: normalized frame-zero boxes x,y,width,height; named regions are image geometry only
source_time_mapping: source seconds = normalized frame index / 24 + segment start, sampling tolerance up to one source-frame interval; no speed changes

cases.name: cube
cases.procedure: Move the purple block into the visible image region target.
cases.justification: Block approaches cup area but robot gripper occludes it; full-run identity cannot be established. Two-dimensional region entry is not containment.

cases.name: peg
cases.procedure: At end, the green box is visible.
cases.justification: Green hollow base remains visibly identifiable in representative start/end frames; SAM identity loss, low confidence or partial gripper occlusion must make this UNKNOWN.

cases.name: nonprehensile
cases.procedure: At end, the green box is visible.
cases.justification: Visible green base at end of a continuous prefix; same-color peg, occlusion or mask confusion may invalidate identity. No insertion claim.

cases.name: perturb
cases.procedure: At end, the green box is visible.
cases.justification: Visible stationary hollow green base; human arm crosses camera and may invalidate continuity. Later source camera cut excluded by segment chosen before inference.
